PRIVACY POLICY
Last Revised: December 22, 2025
1. Scope.
Gold Eagle Cooperative ( GEC ) takes your privacy seriously. This policy explains how GEC collects, uses, and protects Information submitted and collected generally on its website or
through its mobile application (together, the Platform ). This Privacy Policy is not a contract and does not create any contractual rights or obligations.
2. INFORMATION Collected.
Information means information that determines the identity of an individual or business entity.
Registration Data. When registering with our Platform, you will provide Information (such as business name, individual name, address, phone number, and email address).
Sensitive/Personal/Other Information. For our business purpose, GEC may collect the following additional Information:
identifiers (such as contact information);
sensitive/personal information (such as your name, driver's license, employer identification number/social security number, user name and password);
payment, billing, and shipping information; as well as information and documentation on any required licenses and certification if you are buying products and services through the Platform; and
financial information, transaction information, purchase history, internet/electronic activity information, geolocation information, Platform usage information, and inferences from the foregoing.
3. Uses.
GEC uses the Information for business purposes, including without limitation:
Platform. To provide, maintain, personalize, customize, and develop the Platform;
Communication. To communicate with you about your account in the Platform (including transactional activity within your account), and to notify you of things like Platform changes
and updates.
Support. To provide technical support to you and debug our Platform.
Security. To detect security incidents, protecting against malicious, deceptive, fraudulent, or illegal activity, and prosecuting those responsible for that activity.
Quality. To maintain the quality and safety of the Platform, and to enhance, improve and update the Platform.
Auditing. To audit activity in our Platform, including legal, regulatory and industry compliance.
Research and Development. To perform internal research and technological development and demonstration.
Aggregate Non-Identifiable Information. To create aggregated, non-identifiable information from the Information to improve our Platform and for other internal and external purposes.
Email Marketing. To send you marketing emails. You can always 'update your preferences' or 'unsubscribe' from those emails within the body of the email.
4. TRACKING, Disclosing and Sharing.
Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies. Modern web browsers are configured to accept browser cookies by default. You may choose to configure your browser to remove or reject
cookies. If you elect to remove or reject cookies, the functionality of our Platform will be affected. Our platform also uses Google Analytics to help us understand things like how you
navigate through our Platform, and "tracer tags" to help us understand things like your location data (to help you, for example, easily find available inventory of sellers in your
area), and what part of our Platform you are interacting with.
Service Providers. GEC may share Information to certain service providers, as follows:
Credit card processors;
Hosting providers; and
Other contractors providing Platform on our behalf, with the appropriate protective contracts in place.
Retailers. GEC may share your Information with retailers or others with whom you engage in a transaction.
Legal Requirements. GEC may be required by law to disclose your Information, and we will try to take steps to limit any such disclosure.
Change of Ownership. If GEC is acquired or otherwise sell our business, we will transfer all the Information to the successor entity. GEC will try to notify you of any change in
ownership or sale by either posting it on our site or by emailing you (at the email address in the system).
No Sales of Information. GEC does not sell your Information to any third parties.
5. Other Terms.
Application of this Policy. By registering on our Platform, you agree to comply with the terms of this Privacy Policy and that we may process your Information.
Industry Standard Security. While we use industry standard security measures to protect against the loss, misuse, and alteration of the Information under our control, there is no
guaranty that it cannot be compromised.
No Under Age 13. GEC does not intentionally gather Information about visitors who are under the age of 13.
Privacy Concerns. To exercise your rights regarding your Information or if you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please email us at
webmaster@goldeaglecoop.com , call us at: 515-825-3161 , or mail us at PO Box 168, Eagle Grove IA 50533.
Links to Third Party Sites. Our Platform may contain links to other sites and services, which are owned and controlled by others. These third-party sites and services have their
own policies regarding privacy, and you should review those policies.
Revisions to this Policy. GEC may change this policy at any time. Notice of any significant revision will be called out on the Platform for a period of time.
We would love to hear from you, please contact us:
